design_description: Home kit: a bold white base with wide red vertical brush-stroke stripes, giving it a raw, painted feel. The texture breaks the classic stripe structure, adding energy and imperfection. A subtle black accent stroke at the lower side anchors the composition. Away kit: a sleek black base with tonal pinstripes, elevated by a sharp red diagonal brush slash that cuts across the body. Gold trims refine the look, balancing aggression with elegance.
